lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnafas
Mere hamnafas, mere hamnava, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
Main khud dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab, mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: My companion, my kindred voice, spare me betrayal in the guise of friendship and prayers for life when love has all but taken mine.

lines: Main khud dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab, mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: Love's pain has brought me to my last breath, so spare me a prayer for life.

lines: Mere dagh-e-dil se hai roshni
couplets.en: This light comes from the wound in my heart.

lines: Isi roshni se hai zindagi
Mujhe dar hai ai mere charagar
couplets.en: This very light keeps me alive, and I am afraid, my healer.

lines: Mujhe dar hai ai mere charagar
Ye charagh tu hi bujha na de
couplets.en: I fear, my healer, that you yourself may put out this lamp.

lines: Tera kya bharosa hai charagar
couplets.en: What faith can I place in you, my healer?

lines: Mujhe chhod de mere haal par, tera kya bharosa hai charagar
couplets.en: Leave me as I am, my healer, for how can I trust you?

lines: Ye teri navazish-e-mukhtasar, mera dard aur badha na de
couplets.en: This brief kindness of yours may only deepen my pain.

lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnava, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: My companion, my kindred voice, spare me betrayal in the guise of friendship.

lines: Mera azm itna buland hai ke paraye sholon ka dar nahin
couplets.en: My resolve is strong enough to face any flame from outside.

lines: Mera azm itna buland hai ke paraye sholon ka dar nahin
couplets.en: My resolve is strong enough to face any flame from outside.

lines: Mujhe khauf aatish-e-gul se hai
Ye kahin chaman ko jala na de
couplets.en: I fear the fire in the rose may burn the garden down.

lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnafas
Woh uthe hain le ke khum-o-subu, are o Shakeel, kahan hai tu
couplets.en: They have risen with jar and flagon in hand, and where are you, Shakeel?

lines: Tera jaam lene ko bazm mein koi aur haath badha na de
Mere hamnafas, mere hamnava
couplets.en: Someone else in the gathering may reach for your cup, my companion, my kindred voice.

lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnava, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
Main khud dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab, mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: My companion, my kindred voice, spare me betrayal in the guise of friendship and prayers for life when love has all but taken mine.
